text:
Marta: seeing sporadic packet loss between gpu-pool pods across two nodes in us-west-2 ~08:10 UTC. gRPC jobs see tail-latency spikes and a few retries.
Raj: can you share a short repro (ping/tcpdump) and which nodes?
Marta: ping -s 1200 -c 50 from pod A -> pod B: 46/50 replies, 4 timeouts, jitter spikes. pods on node gpu-03 and gpu-07.
Marta: quick tcpdump from host on vxlan interface shows repeated retransmits and duplicate ACKs:
```
12:10:15.123456 IP 10.20.3.12.52000 > 10.20.7.34.8080: Flags [P.], seq 12345:12567, ack 9876, win 29200, length 222
12:10:15.223789 IP 10.20.7.34.8080 > 10.20.3.12.52000: Flags [R.], seq 9876, ack 12567, win 0, length 0
12:10:15.224000 IP 10.20.3.12.52000 > 10.20.7.34.8080: Flags [.], seq 12567, ack 9876, win 29200, length 0
```
Marta: also see kernel log on gpu-07 with mlx5 warnings about sg mapping failures (sporadic).
Olivia: are we running VXLAN or Geneve encap? any MTU changes?
Marta: geneve overlay, host MTU 9000, pod MTU 8900 (encap overhead ~64). No recent MTU changes.
Jeff: we did a kernel rollout to 5.10.102 on that node set last night. mlx5 driver had a few fixes but also regressions on encap offload historically.
sre-oncall: can you check offload flags: `ethtool -k <if>` on the host and on vxlan interface?
Raj: ran `ethtool -k` on gpu-07:
```
Features for vxlan0:
rx-checksumming: on
sg: on
tso: on
gso: on
gro: on
```
Raj: looks like TSO/GSO/GRO are enabled on the tunneled interface (mlx5). That combo + encap sometimes triggers segment reassembly bugs.
Olivia: I remember internal ticket NET-3124 about mlx5 + encapsulation + GSO regressing with some kernel builds. Workaround was to disable tso/gso on the tunnel interface or disable tx offload for the NIC.
Jeff: downside: disabling offloads on vxlan reduces throughput/CPU efficiency, but fixes packet corruption/loss for encapsulated flows in past incidents. Worth trying on a canary subset.
ci-bot: canary job queued: deploy daemonset net-encap-offload-patch -> labels: canary=gpu-encap-fix
Marta: applied DS to gpu-canary-1/gpu-canary-2. I used `ethtool -K vxlan0 tso off gso off gro off` on those hosts and restarted kube-proxy on the nodes. Running iperf and our gRPC load test now (10m).
Marta: early results: canary shows 0/1000 packet loss, p95 latency down 30%. Non-canary still shows intermittent drops.
Raj: collecting netstat -s and bpftrace histograms for retransmits and ksnap of mlx5 errors for root cause.
Olivia: next steps if canary is green: 1) roll to 5% nodes in us-west-2 GPU pool, 2) monitor encap retransmit rate + training job error rate for 1h, 3) roll further or rollback. Create rollback step to re-enable offloads.
Jeff: also open a bug on upstream kernel/mlx5 driver with our tcpdump and kernel logs (include node IDs and kernel versions). Add perf counters.
sre-oncall: added temporary alert: encap.retransmit.rate > 10/min -> paging.
Raj: I pushed a Grafana panel for "encap retransmits" and a simple synthetic gRPC p95 probe.
Marta: proceeding with rollout to 5% now. tagging @networking and @platform for visibility.
Olivia: nice. After roll we should run a focused RCA to see if kernel or driver change triggered offload corruption; if driver, coordinate vendor (Mellanox) patch.
Marta: thanks team. will post follow-up with final numbers. :thumbsup:
